scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text:
We are looking for adventurers who are super curious and extremely brave.
Join us for a wonderful adventure!

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text: Hey, you're a knowledgeable person, right? Are you interested in my story?
Yes.
No, thanks.

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text:
You're a real adventurer.
Good for you!
You won't regret it.

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text:
I usually send adventurers to
newly found places for research.
It's quite challeging, as nobody's ever been to these places.

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text:
The missions are quite dangerous,
so only those who are courageous
are qualified for the challenge
of this mission.

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text: I'm not sure that you're strong enough, but you seem brave. How about going to the kingdom receptionist? He should be in the first room of Prontera Castle.

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text:
From what I've heard about this place... It's not a new continent.
I don't know where it is.
Hmm... Inside of the sky?

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text:
Could just be a rumor,
but I don't know exactly.
It's not my business.

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text:
Anyway, I'm supposed to inform many adventurers about it.
There's no time to waste!

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text: Huh, I thought you were a real adventurer. You're missing a big opportunity. You're definitely not brave. Absolutely not!

scripts.speaker: Alliance Manager
scripts.text: If we'd had the initiative over Schwarzwald, we could take advantage over them! But we lost the opportunity.

scripts.speaker: Alliance Manager
scripts.text:
Though we are allied with them, that's nothing more than a formality.
We will take advantage over them.

scripts.speaker: Alliance Manager
scripts.text: Do you know what we are here for? These are the things that help to have control over multiple countries and get to know their magic.

scripts.speaker: Alliance Manager
scripts.text: Whatever. Though the things are not useful to us, we'd better destroy them, to prevent them from being used by others.

scripts.speaker: Alliance Manager
scripts.text: Anything except things which are not found on Rune-Midgarts... keep them hidden. Just let us know of whatever you are holding.

scripts.speaker: Alliance Manager
scripts.text: ...Do you have any business with me?

scripts.speaker: Alliance Manager
scripts.text:
Hm... The boss had you come to me,
to talk about the issues? Ok!

scripts.speaker: Alliance Manager
scripts.text:
So, everything is going well?
You're allied with Schwarzwald?
They will join with you.
I know this.

scripts.speaker: Alliance Manager
scripts.text: Hm....ok.

scripts.speaker: Alliance Manager
scripts.text:
You are all going, forward through
the dimensional rift...

scripts.speaker: Alliance Manager
scripts.text:
Good. It's started.
We also need to be preparted to not
let ourselves be convinced to turn over.

scripts.speaker: Alliance Manager
scripts.text:
We are so-called 'allies',
so we can't take advantages over
each other in public, but we can do
it secretly.

scripts.speaker: Alliance Manager
scripts.text:
The Schwarzwald... they are all
snobs. I know what they did.
They'll try to get what they can
with little or no work. I know
their dirty tricks.

scripts.speaker: Alliance Manager
scripts.text:
We shouldn't loose anything to them,
no way! We are not as powerful as
most of them.

scripts.speaker: Alliance Manager
scripts.text:
We only have a strange dimensional
rift in our reserves, but nothing
else... Only we are about to trick
them, to win over them!

scripts.speaker: Alliance Manager
scripts.text:
You are a member of our alliance.
Always be careful not to get lost.

scripts.speaker: Alliance Manager
scripts.text:
Thanks for reporting to us.
We are better prepared.
Good job. You can go now.

scripts.speaker: Alliance Manager
scripts.text: Do you have any business here?

scripts.speaker: Member of Alliance
scripts.text: If we have absolute power, we wouldn't have to get along with Schwarzwald and Arunafeltz.

scripts.speaker: Member of Alliance
scripts.text: I don't know when Satan Morocc will attack us, and whether we're powerful enough to detect him.

scripts.speaker: Member of Alliance
scripts.text: We couldn't avoid cooperating with them. We don't have many choices left.

scripts.speaker: Member of Alliance
scripts.text: So we will take advantage over them in secret, in this dimensional rift.

scripts.speaker: Member of Alliance
scripts.text:
If we'd have had more power,
we wouldn't be like this now.
Strength is most important.

scripts.speaker: Recruiter
scripts.text:
Why have you come again?
You'd better go to Schwarzwald to register.

scripts.speaker: Recruiter
scripts.text: What? You came to here to convey a story? Go ahead.

scripts.speaker: Recruiter
scripts.text: Move to the side. There's a Manager who is dealing with all of us, and is involved in international relations here on Midgard.

scripts.speaker: Recruiter
scripts.text: Just talk to him.

scripts.speaker: Recruiter
scripts.text:
Just go there.
You can get nothing from me.
Let's rush to
^FF0000Lighthalzen^000000, which is the original place for the three kingdoms...

scripts.speaker: Recruiter
scripts.text:
I've heard of you.
You've finished the tests from the Promotional Staff?

scripts.speaker: Recruiter
scripts.text:
You are definitely brave enough to venture to this new land.
I will now appoint you to detect and have adventures in Ash-Vacuum.
Ash-Vacuum?

scripts.speaker: Recruiter
scripts.text: Hm. That's the code name of the place where you will have your adventure. Frankly, we don't know exactly what it is, but we call it 'Ash-Vacuum'.

scripts.speaker: Recruiter
scripts.text:
Believe it or not,
it's definitely true.
So listen carefully.
Please.

scripts.speaker: Recruiter
scripts.text: Ash-Vacuum... is a living place... that's totally different from where we are living now.

scripts.speaker: Recruiter
scripts.text:
It's an unknown place.
We don't know what's there,
or who is living there.
It's beyond our guess.
Nobody knows.

scripts.speaker: Recruiter
scripts.text: Only the brave, like you, deserve to go there. There will be many dangerous things around you, but you must explore it on behalf of Midgard.

scripts.speaker: Recruiter
scripts.text: Anyway, I am sure that there are many opportunities for fame and fortune there...

scripts.speaker: Recruiter
scripts.text: First, you should go to ^FF0000Lighthalzen^000000 to register for the United Midgard Alliance. I believe they are meeting at the Rekenber Corporation Headquarters...

scripts.speaker: Recruiter
scripts.text: You can get a detailed guide, better than me, there. Go there and find him...

scripts.speaker: Recruiter
scripts.text: I've done what I can. Go there, and get to it!

scripts.speaker: Recruiter
scripts.text: Remember, go to ^FF0000Lighthalzen^000000, then follow the directions of the guide there.

scripts.speaker: Recruiter
scripts.text:
Just go there!
And listen carefully
about your mission!
I'm done here...

scripts.speaker: Recruiter
scripts.text:
What're you doing here?
Just go to ^FF0000Aldebaran^000000, and find the ^FF0000Promotional Staff^000000. As I advised you, you'd better save time.

scripts.speaker: Recruiter
scripts.text:
Brave ones! Come to me!
Real brave people!
Would you mind trying a challenging mission?

scripts.speaker: Recruiter
scripts.text: I am a recruiter looking for brave people in Prontera! My goal is to recruit the bravest adventurers for this mission.

scripts.speaker: Recruiter
scripts.text:
Would you like to join?
This is always open to you.
I know, you're super curious.
Just try whatever you want.
Yes, I am interested.
No, thanks.

scripts.speaker: Recruiter
scripts.text:
Oh! Yes! You're quite curious!
You're a real adventurer.
A genuine desire for adventure.
Ok! Let me start by telling you the story of the mission!!

scripts.speaker: Recruiter
scripts.text: All of this of course, the Promotional Staff can tell you, but they're not that reliable. So, let me explain to you. Just listen carefully.

scripts.speaker: Recruiter
scripts.text:
Um... There's not that much to tell you...
...

scripts.speaker: Recruiter
scripts.text: The point is that we want someone who is curious and brave, to go to new places. And I choose you!!

scripts.speaker: Recruiter
scripts.text: This is a special place among unknown places. Quite special! I can't tell you much just now. Just believe me that it is truly uncommon!

scripts.speaker: Recruiter
scripts.text:
So, now, let me test you.
Once I get you qualified,
I will tell you everything.

scripts.speaker: Recruiter
scripts.text: Just go to the ^FF0000Promotional Staff^000000 in Aldebaran and get permission. They can judge you more carefully than me. Go ahead.

scripts.speaker: Recruiter
scripts.text: They will take care of everything, if you say that you've been sent by the Recruiter in Prontera.

scripts.speaker: Recruiter
scripts.text:
Time is zeny, just go.
As soon as you visit the Promotional Staff, you will be allowed to travel to the unknown land.

scripts.speaker: Recruiter
scripts.text: Are you seriously enjoying your adventures? You're not that curious.

scripts.speaker: Recruiter
scripts.text: Just go about your business!

scripts.speaker: Recruiter
scripts.text: -Muttering and complaining...-

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text: Did you try out for the test, or are you already enjoying your adventures?

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text: Just visit the ^FF0000Promotional Staff in Geffen^000000. You have no business with me anymore. Bless you. I wish you a safe adventure.

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text:
Don't forget to bring... ^FF0000300 Jellopy^000000.
Got it? ^FF0000300 Jellopy^000000!
Let me know once you got them.

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text:
Hey! Let me know once you collect all of them.
Don't disturb me anymore. I'm a busy man... What a waste.

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text:
Hm? Did you bring all of them?
No! It's quite an annoying job
I'm impressed that you managed to do such a menial thing to bring 300 Jellopy!

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text:
You have guts kid!
You're a good-willed person!
Ok, you win!
You pass!!

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text:
Adventurers like you
are not common
A hard-boiled soldier!
Stronger than me!

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text:
Now can you go to the
Promotional Staff in Geffen?
He will test you again.

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text:
You know this isn't an easy quest.
You resolved to carry it out, didn't you?
Brace yourself for it.

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text:
Anyway you did the first step.
Bless you!

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text: We want the adventurers who are super curious and extremely brave. Join us for a wonderful adventure!

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text: Hey, you're a well-versed person, right? Are you interested in my story?
I have something for you.

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text:
For me??
I hate annoying stuff.

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text:
Ahh... I sensed that I would get your request.
The recruiter sent you here to get tested?
Hmm.

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text:
Ah! They always push me,
to suffer from so much work
I live a hard life!

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text:
My job is testing if you are strong and brave enough for this adventure.
What a bother!

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text:
I will accept you if you bring me ^FF0000300 Jellopy^000000.
I believe that you can bring them to me.
Are you ready?

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text:
Just go ahead and hunt monsters, or whatever and collect 300 jellopies.
Then we can go forward.

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text:
Did you take the test?
Or are you already enjoying your adventure?

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text:
You didn't visit ^FF0000Izlude^000000, did you?
Or do you have any business in Geffen?

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text:
^FF00001 Ruby!!^000000.
Don't you forget it!
Hurry up! Time is zeny!

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text:
Wow, you brought a genuine Jewel.
You are absolutely qualified.
I can tell these things.

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text:
Am I exaggerating?
It's true that you're
considerably strong.

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text:
Ok! My job is done.
Good job!!

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text:
Next step is Izlude!
You can get tested by the Promotional Staff there.
Hurry up!

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text:
The unknown place...
It is a very dangerous place so you must go through these tests before we can send you....
We're pretty picky.

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text:
I hope you can do it!
Good luck!

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text:
The one you should bring me is
^FF0000Emerald^000000. Can you get it?

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text:
You brought it so soon!
You're a real adventurer!
I will accept this Emerald as evidence.

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text:
This isn't something I wanted to keep for myself.
You know that, right?

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text:
Next bring me ^FF00001 Ruby^000000.
I can't judge you with only one jewel.
So I need one more stone.

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text:
Please bring me a Ruby.
As I mentioned, this is the second request.
I will wait until you bring me a stone again.

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text: We are recruiting adventurers who are strong and curious. Try your life at something more challenging.

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text: Hey, you're a knowledgeable person, right? Are you interested in my story?
The Staff in Aldebaran sent me.

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text: Oh he did?

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text: Ok, I guess that it's time for the second part of your test.

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text: I need you to gather some stones for me.

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text:
I will accept you if you bring ^FF00001 Emerald^000000.
Are you ready?

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text:
Just bring me ^ff00001 Emerald^000000.
That isn't hard for you right?
Then we can go forward.

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text: I bless you for your future! May it be full of happiness!

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text:
The test is done!
If you have any other business, go to the palace.

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text:
You don't look that strong.
Nothing but skin and bones!
Not reliable.
You should level up more before
considering this adventure.

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text:
I don't need adventurers who are
body-builders... but at least
someone not so little!!

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text:
Wow! You are considerably
stronger than before!
Let me see...
You look different!

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text: Um...

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text:
Ok, it's done!
You seemed a sore weak of a soul,
but now, you're quite stronger than
before. Great! You will do!!

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text:
We have quite high expectations to meet.
Though the new place is dangerous,
no need to check thoroughly
anymore.

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text:
It's not a hell-hole!
Ukk!

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text:
Anyway, just go back to the
Recruiter. I will forward to him
that you passed all the steps. Good
job, friend!

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text:
Bless all of your heart,
for your great future!

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text:
We are recruiting adventurers
who are quite strong and curious.

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text: Hey, you're a knowledgeable adventurer. Are you interested in my story?
I have something for you.

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text: Um, you're the one sent to be tested, correct? You are in the right place. I'm the Promotional Staff in Izlude.

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text: I guess you're qualified enough to go... I think no more testing is needed.

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text: Let me see...

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text:
I think you're good enough!
No more testing!!
Ok! You pass!

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text:
We have quite high expectations to meet.
Though the new place is dangerous,
no need to check thoroughly right now.

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text:
It's not a hell-hole!
Ukk...

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text:
Anyway, just go back to the recruiter.
I will forward to him that you passed all the steps.
Good job, friend!

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text:
May Freya bless you,
for your great future!

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text: Hmm...

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text:
You don't look that strong.
Nothing but skin and bones!
Not reliable.
I can't let you pass.

scripts.speaker: Promotional Staff
scripts.text:
Please level up a little more. I
can't accept that you're strong
enough. Sorry.

scripts.speaker: Guide
scripts.text: Welcome! You've arrived at Lighthalzen, which is the base of three kingdoms.

scripts.speaker: Guide
scripts.text: You have to register your name. Go to the 2nd floor in Rekenbereu on the northwest side.

scripts.speaker: Guide
scripts.text: Be careful not to lose your way!

scripts.speaker: Guide
scripts.text: Welcome! You've arrived at Lighthalzen, which is the base of three kingdoms.
-At this spot, it's possible to overhear something. Listen carefully through the wall...-

scripts.speaker: Munkenro
scripts.text:
You're a good buddy!
But...

scripts.speaker: Munkenro
scripts.text:
We can't avoid this...
You know better than I!
We can't go through this,
in this current status.

scripts.speaker: Munkenro
scripts.text:
I did all I could do...
Please...

There's no avoiding it.
Ok, I need to try.

scripts.speaker: Munkenro
scripts.text: You are ready to try this...

scripts.speaker: Munkenro
scripts.text: Oh! My friend...

scripts.speaker: Munkenro
scripts.text: Nothing can be controlled anymore... Am I trying this...?

scripts.speaker: Munkenro
scripts.text:
Peace for the three kingdoms...?
Isn't it impossible...?

scripts.speaker: Munkenro
scripts.text:
Are you sure that
you can do that?

scripts.speaker: Munkenro
scripts.text: Nothing shall prevent me from doing my duty. Nothing!

scripts.speaker: Munkenro
scripts.text: Sikaiz is a kind and upright person. But he can't be cautious about everything. It could cause serious problems.

scripts.speaker: Munkenro
scripts.text: So that's why I am here for him. I always worry about him...

scripts.speaker: Munkenro
scripts.text: I don't know what I would do if something were to happen...

scripts.speaker: Sikaiz
scripts.text:
Please come to me ASAP.
I hope you play an active part.

scripts.speaker: Sikaiz
scripts.text: We all expect you to make the biggest impact.

scripts.speaker: Sikaiz
scripts.text: Only thing you should do is write down your name and show me your great face

scripts.speaker: Sikaiz
scripts.text: I already accept you. Just write down your name here. Go ahead.

scripts.speaker: Sikaiz
scripts.text:
Don't you know your own name?
Write it again.

scripts.speaker: Sikaiz
scripts.text:
Ok. I got your name, {0}. Great name! Registration is done!
You've become a member of the three kingdoms!

scripts.speaker: Sikaiz
scripts.text:
All done.
Go to the field Officer of Schwarzwald. He should be in the banquet hall of this building downstairs.

scripts.speaker: Sikaiz
scripts.text: Only thing left for you is to go to the Officer to say that you are leaving now.

scripts.speaker: Sikaiz
scripts.text:
As soon as you tell him,
come back to me again.
You are not the only one expecting this great challenge. I am too.

scripts.speaker: Sikaiz
scripts.text:
I believe you can do it!
It would bear watching you.

scripts.speaker: Sikaiz
scripts.text: See you then.

scripts.speaker: Sikaiz
scripts.text:
You came back!
Fast learner!
I love that you're a member of my alliance.

scripts.speaker: Sikaiz
scripts.text: Our preparations will soon be complete.

scripts.speaker: Sikaiz
scripts.text: We will surely share all our information with the three kingdoms, and study them.

scripts.speaker: Sikaiz
scripts.text: Definitely, you are the one to face all the trials and tribulations.

scripts.speaker: Sikaiz
scripts.text: The important thing is that we need to share all the current information relevant to this place.

scripts.speaker: Sikaiz
scripts.text:
I advise you,
if you get friendly with
the creatures in there,
that's a kind source to know.
I'll believe you.

scripts.speaker: Sikaiz
scripts.text:
Let's conclude.
You need to investigate and report to us as much as possible. That's not that tough.

scripts.speaker: Sikaiz
scripts.text:
Don't worry so much.
We will support you.
As we can.
So I will tell you the last step to becoming a member of the alliance.

scripts.speaker: Sikaiz
scripts.text:
In ^FF0000Cheshrumnir in Rachel^000000,
there is a Manager.

scripts.speaker: Sikaiz
scripts.text: You already met someone like that from Rune-Midgarts. So no more explanation is needed.

scripts.speaker: Sikaiz
scripts.text:
Ok, so we should talk about
the tasks we should go through.
These are about it...

scripts.speaker: Munkenro
scripts.text: Hey, sorry for interrupting you. I also have information to send to Arunafeltz.

scripts.speaker: Munkenro
scripts.text: We're in a hurry.

scripts.speaker: Sikaiz
scripts.text: Hey! You hear that? Sorry I'm sure that you've got many things to do. Can I request one more thing? I can't deal with it myself.

scripts.speaker: Sikaiz
scripts.text: I feel like I am forcing you, but I hope to get your help. Go to the ^FF0000Cheshrumnir Guard^000000 in Rachel and deliver Munkenro's message for me.

scripts.speaker: Sikaiz
scripts.text: It's the same mission you did for Rune-Midgarts, so it shouldn't be that hard. I hope you can do it.

scripts.speaker: Sikaiz
scripts.text:
You did it already?
You are a quick worker.

scripts.speaker: Sikaiz
scripts.text: Anyway, I promised to tell you about the three kingdoms... This is kind of a long story, so please listen carefully.

scripts.speaker: Sikaiz
scripts.text:
The adventurers for Ash-vacuum! The alliance for the three kingdoms! Rune-Midgarts, Schwarzwald, Arunafeltz!
Three kingdoms united for one thing!

scripts.speaker: Sikaiz
scripts.text: Frankly, there's a Dimensional Rift in the Sograt desert, so they can inspect it themselves, but it's not that good of a place to inspect the rift's magic well.

scripts.speaker: Sikaiz
scripts.text: We are a little bit better in magic, but not that much developed in science as compared with Schwarzwald, and not as wise compared with Arunafeltz.

scripts.speaker: Sikaiz
scripts.text: So we need to get help from other countries, because the Ash-vacuum is quite a profitable place. That is why we made the Alliance to get into the Ash-Vacuum.

scripts.speaker: Sikaiz
scripts.text: The three kingdoms were enemies before. Fortunately, it's going well now. It's fine.

scripts.speaker: Sikaiz
scripts.text: This alliance is a first step for peace among the three kingdoms. You know they are all for themselves, so this needs harmony. That's the one thing to pursue, as head of an alliance.

scripts.speaker: Sikaiz
scripts.text: Honestly, I am also forced by my kingdom, to further our own interests and not others.

scripts.speaker: Sikaiz
scripts.text: But the most valuable thing is the unity. Not each kingdom's interest. If we spoil the greatest plans, it's too regrettable.

scripts.speaker: Sikaiz
scripts.text: Though I belong to Schwarzwald, I need to balance the three kingdoms, as a leader... so I can't support my kingdom too much over the others.

scripts.speaker: Sikaiz
scripts.text:
Anyway, I believe that my friend can assist me well.
Though he is from another kingdom, he's supported me thus far.

scripts.speaker: Sikaiz
scripts.text:
He's the man to my left.
We call him Munk.
His real name is... Munkenro.

scripts.speaker: Sikaiz
scripts.text: He is a kind of manager for Schwaltzvald and he is the main contact point of the kingdom's people, since he's quite closely in communication with them.

scripts.speaker: Sikaiz
scripts.text: That's enough talk about the three kingdoms. Now, let's move on to the next stories.

scripts.speaker: Sikaiz
scripts.text: Go to Prontera in Rune-Midgarts and find the Manager there. Tell him that the Alliance is doing well and that we are entering the rift.

scripts.speaker: Sikaiz
scripts.text: So, what do you want to know more of? You already know about the Ash-Vacuum. Is there anything else you'd like me to tell you?
The three kingdoms...

scripts.speaker: Sikaiz
scripts.text: Ah, I need to tell you about the alliance, but first, may I ask something?

scripts.speaker: Sikaiz
scripts.text: I need to report its status to the managers in Rune-Midgarts. I can't do it right now. May I ask you a favor?

scripts.speaker: Sikaiz
scripts.text: It's not that difficult. Just tell them to prepare for the trip to the Dimensional Rift. It's quite easy, isn't it?

scripts.speaker: Sikaiz
scripts.text: We're running out of time, so I will answer you when you come back. Ok?

scripts.speaker: Sikaiz
scripts.text: Whew......

scripts.speaker: Sikaiz
scripts.text: You come to be registered as an adventurer? Then I'm the one to talk to. I am Sikaiz, the head of the United Midgard Alliance.

scripts.speaker: Sikaiz
scripts.text: You come here from Prontera? Then you have been sent by the Recruiter. Didn't he tell you about the stories? Maybe he thought that I would tell you everything.

scripts.speaker: Sikaiz
scripts.text: I can tell you, but, he's so obstinate. So many kinds of people are living in this world, but quite few are as obstinate as him.

scripts.speaker: Sikaiz
scripts.text: The registration is also important now, but I will tell you about our status here. May I begin?
Sure.

scripts.speaker: Sikaiz
scripts.text: Ok. Let me tell you about the Ash-Vacuum. It's quite a long story. So please bear with me.

scripts.speaker: Sikaiz
scripts.text:
^FF0000Ash-Vacuum^000000....
This isn't the world of mortals.
Then what is it...
Nobody knows.

scripts.speaker: Sikaiz

that have made positive
impacts on Midgard.
You're one of them, huh?

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text:
...That's great!
I think I've finally found
a silver lining. God has
sent me a savior.
And I think that's you!

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text:
Please, don't say you
don't want to help me.
Can't you see that.
I'm shivering in fear?
Please help me. Will you?

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text:
As I told you earlier,
I have an elder twin
brother, Terris Block...

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text:
He's a botanist. He's
extremely strong and
extroverted, unlike me.
I think he hates me because
I represent weakness, and
he is the complete opposite.

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text:
...Oh, that's not what I wanted
to say. I wanted to show my
discovery regarding the
Nepentheses to my brother.

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text:
I need a Nepenthes specimen,
but I don't have the tools to
make one, my luggage is still
on transfer. And it's not like
I've packed enough tools, so...

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text:
To make my specimen tools,
I need ^3131FF1 Empty Bottle,
5 Holy Waters, and
30 Sticky Mucus^000000.

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text:
You know what I'm.
asking here, don't you?
Help me, help me, please.

You call yourself a monster
scholar, and yet you're afraid
of practicing your expertise.
You're nothing but a coward.

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text:
I can take your criticism,
but I can't hide my true feelings.

Come on, you're a respected
monster scholar. You'll find
that the monsters in this world
aren't that different from the
ones in Midgard. Why don't
you see for yourself?

- Rumis didn't seem -
- to be convinced. -
- He shook his head in refusal. -

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text:
I'm not going to go
outside of my tent.
Not ever.

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text:
Thank you.
you've brought the materials.

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text:
While you were collecting the
materials, I've sent out soldiers
to catch a few Nepentheses.

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text:
Nepenthes looks extremely
similar to Mandragora on
the Midgard Continent.

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text:
Both of them must share the
same ancestor, but apparently
Nepenthes has evolved to
become stronger and more
aggressive due to this
barren environment.

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text:
I wonder how the ancestors
were scattered over
two different worlds...

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text:
Maybe they went through
the World Tree Yggdrasil?
Maybe it came along with
other creatures such as
Satan Morocc and traversed
through time and space.

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text: The characteristics of this species are...

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text:
Oh, where are my manners?
I'm sorry if I bored you by
talking academic nonsense...
Let's talk about something
else, shall we?

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text:
Do you think...
My brother will be happy to
see this Nepenthes specimen?
You know, Nepenthes is a
plant monster, and that's
my brother's specialty.

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text:
Please deliver this specimen to Terris Block
He's near the expedition camp.
No, you won't have to sit through my brother's reaction... If it's bad.

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text:
- You have received a-
- Nepenthes Specimen -
- from Rumis Block. -

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text:
To make my specimen tools,
I need ^3131FF1 Empty Bottle, 5 Holy Waters, and 30 Sticky Mucus^000000.

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text: You know what I'm asking here, don't you? Thank you in advance.

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text:
Did you deliver the Nepenthes Specimen to my brother Terris?
He's at the east of the camp.

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text:
...Welcome back.
Oh, you don't have to tell me what my brother said,
because someone from his side already came by. His report really impressed management, huh?

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text: Yes, that's my brother......

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text: ...Anyways, one of the soldiers that captured Nepentheses for me has given me some interesting information.

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text: Over the eastern bridge, he found a new type of monster.

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text: According to his description, the monster is suspected to be a member of the long-haired Cat family. I'd like to see it with my own eyes, but...

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text: As you know, I'm not yet ready to face any types of monsters in this world...

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text:
Can you escort me while I'm studying that species?
Please, I'm begging you!
Okay.
No.

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text:
Wow, thanks!
Then I'd better pack my stuff right away...

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text:
It won't take long. Can you please go wait for me over the eastern bridge?
Don't... Don't go too far from the bridge!

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text:
I'll pack my stuff and follow you. Can you please go wait for me over the rightward bridge?
Don't... Don't go too far from the bridge!
- Rumis is hurriedly packing his stuff. -

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text: Apparently, an extremely intelligent creature inhabits Ash Vaccum.

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text: An explorer went over the rightward bridge to find some wood. In the darkness, something really big rushed at him from far away.

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text: When he came back to his senses, there was nothing but a tricorn hat left on the ground.

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text: The tricorn is woven in a way that was never introduced to Midgard, and its materials are also unidentifiable.

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text: Does it mean another race of human resides here? Would they be fairies or something else?

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text: What if they've detected us and tried to drive us away... Wah!

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text:
Even thinking of them send chills down on my spine! Can you please go check what kind of races reside at the end of the land over the rightward bridge?
I want to know if they're friendly or hostile to us.

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text: Welcome back. Did you find out about them?
Well, let's see...

The owner of the tricorn hat
is a monster called...
^FF0000Tatacho^000000
{0}...? I don't think that was the name...
The size of Tatacho is about...
Tatachos are usually sitting on the ground, but they roll around if their body temperature goes down too low because of the cold weather.
About that tricorn hat, I've concluded, based on my opinion about their appearance and their movement patterns, that it is not active or productive at all:
They are not intelligent enough to produce a sophisticated hat like that.

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text:
......
You now sound like me... I guess I've stained you with my academic manner of speech. Oh, I'm not saying it is bad, but...

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text:
Anyways, according to your conclusion, the hat must have been given to them by someone else, or they could have picked it up after another creature dropped it.
Thank you for such valuable information.
It's enough to write a report.

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text: I should make a brief report and then submit it to management. Hopefully, a new monster scholar after me will do a better job in actually studying them.

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text:
There are many cold places in my country, the Schwarzwald Republic, but none are as cold as this place. This weather is freezing my senses, dulling my passion toward my studies.
I shall go back home faster than anyone else in this camp. I'm tired of this world...

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text:
...{0}, I thank you so much for helping me despite my self-centered behavior.
I really appreciate it

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text:
I'll repay your favor as soon as I go back home.
I hope you'll make yourself known in Ash Vacuum with your great accomplishments.

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text: Can you please go check what kind of races reside at the end of the land over the rightward bridge? I want to know if they're friendly or hostile to us.
Mr. Rumis! Take a look at this!

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text:
...Oh, hello.
I'm extremely frustrated. I feel helpless because I wasn't able to go back home last time...

I've found this horn from a monster in the Splendide Area.
That monster was very mysterious, and its body was covered with grass.

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text:
Ho... Covered with grass?
...I know you're excited, but that doesn't sound interesting to me. Sorry.

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text: Let me take a look at the horn.

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text: Hmm.

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text: Uhmm...

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text: Huh...?

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text:
...This is remarkable.
...This horn looks very similar to that of the Hillsrions that inhabit the Manuk area.

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text:
I wonder if they're related,
or if this is an evolved Hillsrion.
Ah, and there's the possibility of mutation caused by the environment.

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text:
...What do you mean?
Are you saying the monster has been mutated by environmental causes?
Well, that's possible, isn't it? Haha!
- You told Rumis what you've heard from Botanist Terris: some plants are already showing signs of mutation. -

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text:
Oh, that's interesting.
If such a device really exists, it's possible to cause abnormal growth to monsters by injecting them with special energy.

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text: By the way, who came up with the idea of that device?
I have no idea. Haha!

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text:
I see...
Mutants caused by a man-made device... Then there might be more mutated creatures in addition to Tendrillion.

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text:
...Now I'm very curious.
But... I want to go back home... It's no use studying them if the management will order me to return.

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text:
I guess my brother really likes this place.
I mean, he's working so hard to figure things out...

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text:
Well, not everyone can live the same life.
I just hope he'll have a better understanding about me...

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text:
I don't know if people in Midgard will welcome me back.
Thanks to you, I at least have a few interesting stories to tell them.

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text:
If you're going to stick around here longer, please help my brother with his study.
I might want to come back later once this area is fully explored and developed...
- With a shy smile on the face, Rumis Block asked you to shake hands, and then turned around hurriedly. -
- You really hope that Rumis will be able to go back home. -

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text:
...I submitted the report to the management, but they have not yet ordered me to go back home...
...*Sigh* I guess nothing's as easy as I'd hoped.
- Rumis seems anxious and scatterbrained. -

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text: When can I go back to Midgard...? *Sigh*

This new land!
Undiscovered life!
Everything about this world excites me.

scripts.text:

This is how it goes...

scripts.text:

scripts.text:
Oh, okay... Ah-hah!

Express your displeasure.
Agree with him.
Your excitement agitates me.

scripts.speaker: Botanist
scripts.text:
Err? Ahahahaha!
Oh, come on! I'm just being happy.
By the way, is there anything I can help you with?
I agree. There's so much to see around here!

scripts.speaker: Botanist
scripts.text:
Ahahaha!
Nice to meet you, my friend.
So, is there anything I can help you with?
Your brother wanted me to send this to you. Maybe it'll help with your study.
- You have given the Nepenthes Specimen to the botanist. -

scripts.speaker: Botanist
scripts.text: Oh...? Isn't this?!

scripts.speaker: Botanist
scripts.text: ...Well, I've got a ton of samples of this specimen. Sorry.
- He points at a pile of specimens in the tent. -

scripts.speaker: Botanist
scripts.text: Still, I'm impressed. I always thought my brother could never do anything on his own. But look, he was able to collect a Nepenthes specimen.

scripts.speaker: Botanist
scripts.text:
Then again, I had this strong feeling that someone has helped him.
That someone was probably you, right?~

scripts.speaker: Botanist
scripts.text:
Either way, I don't care.
I'm just happy that he cares about me...

Why do you think that?
Can't you just thank him for trying to help you?

scripts.speaker: Botanist
scripts.text:
Well, you must forget that he and I are twins.
We are spiritually connected to each other.

scripts.speaker: Botanist
scripts.text: Usually twins share the same feelings and ideas, I can see what he does or thinks if I try hard.

scripts.speaker: Botanist
scripts.text:
Let me see what Rumis is doing right now... Oh, he's picking his nose with his left hand and eating a slice of bread with his right.
God, how disgusting!
Go check Rumis if it's true.
Do not trust his word.

scripts.speaker: Botanist
scripts.text:
Hahaha!
Muhahaha!
Let me guess, you want to go check Rumis to see if I'm telling the truth. Am I wrong?
Hahahaha! Sorry, but I lied. I mean, remote vision? Because we're twins?

scripts.speaker: Botanist
scripts.text:
God, you're so funny. Hahaha~
You please me, just like the new creatures blooming on the World Tree.~

scripts.speaker: Botanist
scripts.text:
Oh,
won't you cut me some slack? I was just joking to melt the ice.
This world is too barren and tough to live without good humor and jokes, you know?

scripts.speaker: Botanist
scripts.text:
Anyways, as I said, I've got a lot of Nepenthes specimens.
But I'll gratefully take this pretentious gift of his.

scripts.speaker: Botanist
scripts.text: This may be an unexpected question, but... Are you interested in meeting dangerous girls playing on a field?
Dangerous girls?

scripts.speaker: Botanist
scripts.text:
Yes, femme fatales!
I've seen girls that are so beautiful.
They're too dangerous to get close, but that's what make them so irresistibly attractive. Do you understand what I'm saying?
It's... Hard to say.

scripts.speaker: Botanist
scripts.text:
Have you explored the area over the bridge at the right side of the united expedition camp?
Then you know the area is so cold that it'll instantly freeze your heart.

scripts.speaker: Botanist
scripts.text:
You should go across the leftward bridge, you'll be surprised to see what's ahead of you.
It's yet to be known how such a thing can happen.
What are you talking about?

scripts.speaker: Botanist
scripts.text:
Well...
I suppose I don't have the words to really describe such an amazing scene.

scripts.speaker: Botanist
scripts.text: I'll send a message to the garrison for you. Why don't you go see it with your own eyes? You won't be disappointed!

scripts.speaker: Botanist
scripts.text:
Of course, I'm offering such an extraordinary service because there's something I want in return. Ahahaha!
...Truth be told, I'm having some trouble. And I need someone to help me.

scripts.speaker: Botanist
scripts.text:
For now, you should go across the leftward bridge. Speak to a guard over there, and then just go ahead.
A group of beautiful girls will welcome you. I hope you'll enjoy having a conversation with them. Maybe you'll get to understand the mystery of nature.

scripts.speaker: Botanist
scripts.text: Yes, I only need... ^3131FF30^000000 of them.

scripts.speaker: Botanist
scripts.text:
Welcome back! How was it?
It was amazing, wasn't it?

scripts.speaker: Botanist
scripts.text:
On the right side of this united expedition camp,
we have a land surrounded by roaring blizzards.

scripts.speaker: Botanist
scripts.text:
And on the other side,
we have a peaceful green land
where we can enjoy Mother Nature's warm embrace.

scripts.speaker: Botanist
scripts.text:
Two completely different worlds coexist
within a short distance of each other.
Where else can you see such amazing contrasts at a glance?

scripts.speaker: Botanist
scripts.text: I'm curious to know all secrets about this world.

scripts.speaker: Botanist
scripts.text:
I'm so excited that I can't hide it!
*Pant Pant*
*Pant Pant*
What a mysterious world this is!

scripts.speaker: Botanist
scripts.text:
Yes, it is...
Oh, right!
Actually I'm here to study this strange phenomenon.

scripts.speaker: Botanist
scripts.text:
To understand the environmental conditions,
including temperature and humidity,
5.....and check the families and growth of plants,
I've installed several special environmental meters
in this area.

scripts.speaker: Botanist
scripts.text:
Unfortunately, some evil monsters
keep destroying the precious meters
with their ^3131FFHeinous Hoops^000000!

scripts.speaker: Botanist
scripts.text:
The culprits are called Cornus.
I'd like to ask you to teach them not to destroy my devices again.

scripts.speaker: Botanist
scripts.text: How'd you like to hunt ^3131FF10 of them^000000 to set an example? Good luck!

scripts.speaker: Botanist
scripts.text:
For now, you should go across the leftward bridge. Speak to a guard over there, and then just go ahead.
A group of beautiful girls will welcome you. I hope you'll enjoy having a conversation with them. Maybe you'll get to understand the mystery of nature.

scripts.speaker: Botanist
scripts.text: Hopefully the Cornuses have learned their lesson, and won't touch my special environmental meters anymore.

scripts.speaker: Botanist
scripts.text: Oh Karyl, while you were away, I received an interesting report from one of my research machines that remained intact.

scripts.speaker: Botanist
scripts.text: According to the report, The original weather condition of Ash Vacuum is cold and dry, just like the land on the right side.

scripts.speaker: Botanist
scripts.text: That means, somebody has artificially cultivated the leftward land.

scripts.speaker: Botanist
scripts.text:
Do you remember seeing strange mushroom shaped buildings everywhere in the fields?
I suspect it to be an environmental purifier that converts barren land into lush, green fields.

scripts.speaker: Botanist
scripts.text:
Let me show you.
Please take this rotting plant stem,
I'll meet you at the environmental purifier standing right next to the leftward bridge on the other side.

scripts.speaker: Botanist
scripts.text:
Cornuses are breaking my special environmental meters!
Please show them the power of Midgardians!

scripts.speaker: Botanist
scripts.text: I'll meet you at the environmental purifier standing right next to the leftward bridge on the other side.

scripts.speaker: Botanist
scripts.text:
I submitted a report to upper management.
I haven't received any response, but I'm sure they'll be as excited as I am once they read the report. Woohoo!

scripts.speaker: Camp Guard
scripts.text:
Stop!
You're about to enter an area that has not been fully explored.
Only personnel--researchers and explorers--authorized by United Midgard and the garrison are allowed to enter the danger zone.
I want to enter the next area.
I want to stay.

scripts.speaker: Camp Guard
scripts.text:
Please be careful out there.
If you encounter any threats or strange phenomenon, then please don't hesitate to report to us at the garrison.

scripts.speaker: Camp Guard
scripts.text: No, you can't. Please return to the expedition camp.

scripts.speaker: Botanist
scripts.text: This is it.

scripts.speaker: Botanist
scripts.text:
Look.
You can tell the pileus is creating drops of light which drip to the ground.

scripts.speaker: Botanist
scripts.text: Please try to plant the rotting stem in the ground.

scripts.speaker: Botanist
scripts.text: Please try to plant the rotting stem in the ground.

scripts.speaker: Botanist
scripts.text: Please try to plant the rotting stem in the ground.
It's sprouted! That shoot looks healthy!

scripts.speaker: Botanist
scripts.text:
See?
This giant mushroom, otherwise known as an Environmental Purifier, not only brings dying plants back to life, but also stimulates their growth.

scripts.speaker: Botanist
scripts.text:
Isn't it amazing?!
This finding will surely stir up the academic world.

scripts.speaker: Botanist
scripts.text:
Now, I should get back to work. I need to write a report based on my study results.
I can't wait to see how the expedition management will react to my report. Hahaha~

scripts.speaker: Botanist
scripts.text:
Oh, right... Rumis!
Can you please tell him that I've received his Nepenthes specimen safely?

scripts.speaker: Botanist
scripts.text: And don't forget to tell him that I've produced great research results. That'll make him cry like a baby. Hahahaha!
- You dug a hole into the ground, planted the rotting stem, and then watered it. -

- Pzzzz -
- Ssshuhhhh -
- Something is growing out of the dirt. -

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text: This is it! Come to the small tree in the southeast direction!
Knock, knock. Are you here?
- Something is making loud noise near the top of the tree. -

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text:
...Oh, yes. Yes!
Monsters were looking at me, so I climbed up this tree without even thinking!
How can I get down now?

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text:
Oh wait, I can see everything so clearly from here.
I guess staying here will be much safer and easier for studying monsters.

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text:
...I'm looking at Hillsrion, the creature that people are talking about.
It's covered with soft fur that reminds me of soft ice flakes floating in the air.
...Oh, sorry.. I was just talking to myself.

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text: I'll be watching the Hillsrions from this tree. {0}, can you please go collect ^3131FFHillsrion Horns^000000 for me?

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text:
Their horns might possess a special power. And I want to have them for further research.
...5 horns will be enough.

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text: I'd like to study Hillsrion's Horns. Please bring 5 of them for me, okay.

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text: ...*Shiver*...

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text:
...*Shiver*...
...*Shiver*...

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text:
...*Shiver*...
...*Shiver*...
...*Shiver*...

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text:
Ah! You're back!
Phew...

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text:
Are you okay? Their fangs look so sharp and shiny...
Oh right, you're an expert when it comes to this kind of job. Hahaha, I don't have to worry about you anymore.

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text:
Have you brought Hillsrion's Horns?
Those are the horns in your hands?

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text: Oh...

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text: Ho...

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text:
Well, they appear to be ordinary horns with a spiral pattern.
Monsters with such horns are a dime a dozen in Midgard.

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text: I, however, still have no idea how Hillsrions use their horns.

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text: If they have bad vision, they could use the horns as feelers, or... I know you don't want to hear me ramble on with my conjecture. Sorry.

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text: We can call it a day for today. Thanks to you, I now feel confident enough to at least come to this tree by myself next time.

scripts.speaker: Rumis Block
scripts.text: Let's go back to the camp. Shall we? I have something to discuss with you.

It's a fairy!

scripts.speaker: Hibba Agip
scripts.text:

I must say that I'm quite impressed.

scripts.speaker: Hibba Agip

scripts.speaker: Instructor Igrid
scripts.text:
Come on, boss... Er, Commander!
Don't you think you're exaggerating?

scripts.speaker: Hibba Agip
scripts.text: The officials are ^0000FFMinister Laur^000000 of the Rune-Midgarts' Kingdom, ^0000FFPriest Nuria^000000 of Arunafeltz, and ^0000FFGerhart^000000 of the Schwatzvalt Republic.

scripts.text: A messenger, who will inform the official of your arrival, is waiting for you at the time-space gap to Midgard. You'd better find him before you leave.

scripts.speaker: Hibba Agip
scripts.text: Since the officials are busy attending to national matters, they won't meet you unless they're informed of your arrival beforehand. I doubt those pretentious guys would even want to see me.

scripts.speaker: Hibba Agip
scripts.text: Travel safely, adventurer, and come back in one piece, alright?

scripts.speaker: Hibba Agip
scripts.text: Haven't you left yet? It's hard to make ends meet, isn't it?

scripts.speaker: Hibba Agip
scripts.text: I mean, if you want to be paid, you'll have to work. Do you still not understand? I'm saying that you better proceed with your mission.

scripts.speaker: Hibba Agip
scripts.text: Hmm...

scripts.speaker: Hibba Agip
scripts.text: Alright, alright. I know why you've come to see me.

scripts.speaker: Staff Officer Abidal
scripts.text: They haven't gotten the report yet. We should send out soldiers...

scripts.speaker: Hibba Agip
scripts.text: That's not why I'm concerned. The problem is that the assignee failed to complete the mission and lost the report.

scripts.speaker: Hibba Agip
scripts.text: Anyways... It's alright. You don't have to feel bad. I understand you didn't mean it this way.

scripts.speaker: Instructor Igrid
scripts.text: Commander, who might have done this? I will destroy him myself.

scripts.speaker: Hibba Agip
scripts.text: Don't impose. Our troops aren't just from one nation, they are from thre different countries, and are here to pursue their country's own interest.

scripts.speaker: Staff Officer Abidal
scripts.text: Hard to say... who is behind this. If I had to guess, either side could be behind this...

scripts.speaker: Hibba Agip
scripts.text: *Spit* This is why I don't trust politicians. Abidal, resolving this incident is your top priority.

scripts.speaker: Hibba Agip
scripts.text: Igrid, evaluate the security of this camp and discipline among the soldiers.

scripts.speaker: Hibba Agip
scripts.text: Now it's your turn... Abidal disposed reports from various departments after he used them to compile the expedition report.

scripts.speaker: Hibba Agip
scripts.text: We take the security of our documents seriously. So... There are no extra copies of the expedition report.

scripts.speaker: Staff Officer Abidal

scripts.speaker: Hibba Agip

scripts.speaker: Hibba Agip

scripts.speaker: Staff Officer Abidal

scripts.text: Who would have thought that that outsiders would be treated so vulgar by the leaders of the other tribes?

scripts.speaker: Hibba Agip
scripts.text: I have said before this thing is not the last, and certainly there is something waiting for us.

scripts.speaker: Hibba Agip
scripts.text: It is time for us to head out, is it not, instructor?

scripts.speaker: Staff Officer Abidal
scripts.text: Right... It's time...

scripts.speaker: Instructor Igrid
scripts.text: I'm ready.

scripts.speaker: Hibba Agip
scripts.text: I am looking forward to what will happen... Whew...

scripts.speaker: Hibba Agip
scripts.text: *Sigh* Look at me, I used to command the desert of Morocc, but I've been deployed to a world that only God knows where...

scripts.speaker: Staff Officer Abidal
scripts.text: Come on, that's not true. In fact, you used to be an official of a small town, and have been promoted to the commander of the expedition. Your success is almost too good to be true.

scripts.speaker: Instructor Igrid
scripts.text: Hey, boss. Can we just go through the motions until we get out of here? This so-called Ash-Vacuum is boring. It's heaven for the kingdom scholars, but it's not for me.

scripts.speaker: Hibba Agip

scripts.speaker: Staff Officer Abidal
scripts.text: The Midgard Expedition is conducted by a group of explorers from the three countries of Midgard and the Mercenary Association. We're here to explore the Ash-Vacuum.

scripts.speaker: Staff Officer Abidal
scripts.text: Command Hibba Agip behind me is our commander. He may appear unreliable, but he has extensive knowledge and experience in exploration.

scripts.speaker: Staff Officer Abidal
scripts.text: We have many aides and scholars to support our expedition.

scripts.speaker: Staff Officer Abidal
scripts.text: Oh, you may know this already, but Commander Agip isn't from any of the three countries. Neither am I or Instructor Igrid.

scripts.speaker: Staff Officer Abidal
scripts.text: There's an obvious power struggle among the three countries to assign their officers to the commander position.

scripts.speaker: Staff Officer Abidal
scripts.text: As a last resort, they had to select Commander Agip since he's unaffiliated with any of those countries, but is talented enough to lead the expedition.

scripts.speaker: Staff Officer Abidal
scripts.text: We, the commanders, Igrid, and I aren't used to the leadership role. We're having trouble taking care of everything that's happening. *Sigh*

scripts.speaker: Staff Officer Abidal
scripts.text: The members of the Midgard Expedition are conducting various kinds of research about the Ash-Vacuum searching for possible living creatures and studying what might be beneficial for the development of the mainland.

scripts.speaker: Staff Officer Abidal

scripts.speaker: Staff Officer Abidal
scripts.text: If you look around this camp, you'll find many opportunities to help us. We always welcome every bit of help.

scripts.speaker: Staff Officer Abidal
scripts.text: So far, only a few truths about the Ash-Vacuum have been revealed.

scripts.speaker: Staff Officer Abidal

scripts.speaker: Staff Officer Abidal
scripts.text: My advice for you will be to be careful when you encounter members of that race. Who knows? They might be extremely hostile toward other races.

scripts.speaker: Staff Officer Abidal
