Why are you back?
You're irresponsible. How could you abandon such an important duty?
If you don't want to work, why did you even come here to the Ash Vacuum in the first place?

scripts.speaker: Echinacea
scripts.text:
Alas! There's no one I can trust!
You know, when I was working at the palace, I was.. *Blah Blah*...
- Her rant doesn't seem to be ending any time soon. You'd better go back and help Mr. Kidd, even if your heart's not in it. -

scripts.speaker: Echinacea
scripts.text:
Hm? Where are you going? I'm not finished!
Hey, hey!

scripts.speaker: Echinacea
scripts.text:
Mr. Kidd is such a great young man.
You should be thankful that I've assigned you to help him. Don't be lazy by neglecting your duties.

scripts.speaker: Echinacea
scripts.text:
Oh, welcome back!
I knew you would successfully complete your duties.
So, tell me; how can I help you?

scripts.speaker: Echinacea
scripts.text:
A scholar who is familiar with magic?
What about that old man over there? If you couldn't tell, he comes from a distant country.
Why are you looking for a scholar, anyway?

scripts.speaker: Echinacea
scripts.text:
Did Mr. Kidd ask you to find one?
I see. He's probably looking for a solution for the spell scroll.
Then yes, that old man would be the perfect person to ask.

scripts.speaker: Echinacea
scripts.text:
He's from Arunafeltz, and has extensive knowledge in magic as well as sacred power.
I'm sure he'll be able to help you.
Who?

scripts.speaker: Echinacea
scripts.text:
Do you see an old man over there? He's trying to make a fire with wet firewood to roast a sweet potato.
His name is Mr. ^4d4dffDefaria^000000.

scripts.speaker: Echinacea
scripts.text: Why don't you go show it to him? He might be able to help Mr. Kidd with what he is trying to do.

scripts.speaker: Echinacea
scripts.text:
If you're seeking advice about the spell scroll, you should go talk to Mr. Defaria.
I don't practice magic, so I wouldn't know anything about it.

scripts.speaker: Echinacea
scripts.text:
Oh, welcome back.
How can I help you?
Oh... You've brought the journal..

scripts.speaker: Echinacea
scripts.text:
I see...
...Basically it all comes down to Rayan.
He's been abducted by Satan Morocc.
If we find Rayan using this location-tracing spell.
We'll find Satan Morocc too!

scripts.speaker: Echinacea
scripts.text:
That's right.
But it'll work only if Satan Morocc actually abducted Rayan.

scripts.speaker: Echinacea
scripts.text: Say, what's the tracing pattern number?

scripts.speaker: Echinacea
scripts.text:
[{0}]
...Ah, there it is.

scripts.speaker: Echinacea
scripts.text:
[{0}]
It's not working for some reason.
I can't find a magic stone that has the same wavelength as yours.

scripts.speaker: Echinacea
scripts.text:
This location-tracing spell uses a pair of magic stones of the same wavelength...
We can use the spell with one stone to find the other stone with the matching wavelength.

scripts.speaker: Echinacea
scripts.text:
We'll analyze this pattern number and detect the wavelength.
It'll take some time before we get the results.

scripts.speaker: Echinacea
scripts.text:
This location-tracing spell uses a pair of magic stones of the same wavelength..
I can't find a magic stone that has the same wavelength as your pattern number.

scripts.speaker: Echinacea
scripts.text: Go check the number again.

scripts.speaker: Echinacea
scripts.text:
Welcome, adventurer.
I hope they've been able to trace the wavelength by now.
How'd you like to go check the results?

scripts.speaker: Echinacea
scripts.text:
To the south of this camp, you'll see a building with a mana detector attached to it.
Go ask the building manager about the trace results.

scripts.speaker: Echinacea
scripts.text:
Tracing magic wavelength is not easy as you think.
Please be patient: the results will arrive soon enough.

scripts.speaker: Echinacea
scripts.text:
I'm in charge of tracing the wavelength from the Midgard Continent,
and the south camp is tracing it in this area.

scripts.speaker: Echinacea
scripts.text:
I asked them to assign top priority to this task, so with any luck, they've finished it by now.
..What are you doing? I said, go ask the building manager about the trace results.

scripts.speaker: Echinacea
scripts.text: How are the results?
- You told her exactly what you were told by the soldier managing the building. -

scripts.speaker: Echinacea
scripts.text:
Oh, is that the case? I see.
That means.. The man called Rayan isn't on the Midgard Continent or in this Ash Vacuum.

scripts.speaker: Echinacea
scripts.text:
He must be somewhere else.
As I suspected, he must be with Satan Morocc.

scripts.speaker: Echinacea
scripts.text:
Pursuing Satan Morocc was supposed to be our last resort..
...I guess we have no choice now..

scripts.speaker: Echinacea
scripts.text:
...I should log a report entry into this journal.
Our pursuit of Satan Morocc is at an end for now.

scripts.speaker: Echinacea
scripts.text:
You did a great job helping us, and went above and beyond my expectations.
Here, this is a reward for your help.

scripts.speaker: Echinacea
scripts.text: Keep up the good work assisting the explorers in this camp.

scripts.speaker: Echinacea
scripts.text: Hmm..

scripts.speaker: Echinacea
scripts.text:
...Grr...!
What?! What do you want?
Why do you keep giving me that dirty look?!
Nothing.
Something is bothering me...

scripts.speaker: Echinacea
scripts.text:
Argh...!
Are you annoying me on purpose?
Go and find something else to do!

scripts.speaker: Echinacea
scripts.text:
I'm stressed out and I've got a headache writing this report. I don't have the time to deal with you right now.
Do you understand?

scripts.speaker: Echinacea
scripts.text:
What is it that worries you?
Please, I've got enough worries already.

scripts.speaker: Echinacea
scripts.text:
So, tell me, what is it?
{0}, you've done a great job helping us...
Oh, you must have questions about that last case, is that right?

scripts.speaker: Echinacea
scripts.text:
...Wait, are you worried because of him?
...I see, you're worried about him being supported by the country.

scripts.speaker: Echinacea
scripts.text:
This isn't a good time to disclose the truth. It'll cause more confusion.
I believe the diplomats and presidents of both countries are responsible for those national matters.

scripts.speaker: Echinacea
scripts.text:
This is out of your hands, adventurer.
So stop worrying about it. Alright?

scripts.speaker: Echinacea
scripts.text:
No country wants to start a war, especially when we have a greater common enemy.
Just focus on what you can do to help us.

scripts.speaker: Echinacea
scripts.text:
We've stopped pursuing Satan Morocc, so you may go help the other explorers now.
I've already rewarded you for your services.

scripts.speaker: Echinacea
scripts.text: Remember; don't open your mouth about this to anyone.

scripts.speaker: Echinacea
scripts.text:
What is it? I thought you've been discharged from my service.
..What are these sweet potatoes?
Did that old man send these?
No way..! Are you..?
That's right.

scripts.speaker: Echinacea
scripts.text:
What do you not understand?
Nothing good can come out of this if it's released to the public.
Can't you see?

scripts.speaker: Echinacea
scripts.text:
Arunafeltz has replaced their leaders with the moderates just recently.
Shoving the remnants of the radicals in front of them is extremely dangerous.

scripts.speaker: Echinacea
scripts.text:
We've finally made a truce with them.
Their sins will not be forgiven, but we won't make a stupid attempt to get revenge and end up shedding more blood!

scripts.speaker: Echinacea
scripts.text:
Let the politicians do their job.
I assure you they won't lead us to the worst case scenario. That's what you're worried about, right?

scripts.speaker: Echinacea
scripts.text:
No, wait.. Do you..?
Do you want us to wage war against Arunafeltz over this?!

scripts.speaker: Echinacea
scripts.text:
Let me ask you to forget the past and focus on the present.
For everyone's sake, please just look toward the future and move forward.

scripts.speaker: Echinacea
scripts.text:
We won't do anything that you'd morally oppose.
You believe in peace, don't you?
Tell him that I'm grateful for these sweet potatoes, anyway..

Err? I don't have two Nice Sweet Potatoes..
Where can I get those?

scripts.speaker: Echinacea
scripts.text:
Let us take care of the rest.
I'm not suggesting that we should pretend as if the past never happened. All I'm saying is that we should work towards achieving a greater cause.

scripts.speaker: Echinacea
scripts.text:
You're doing a great job.
I suppose I have an eye for people after all.
Yes, that must be right.
Keep up the good work, will you?

scripts.speaker: Manager
scripts.text:
Everything's okay so far!
How may I help you?

scripts.speaker: Manager
scripts.text:
Everything's okay so far!
How may I help you?

scripts.speaker: Manager
scripts.text:
This device detects mana and magic wavelengths around this area. identifying what enemies we're dealing with.
It can be used to trace the wavelengths of location-tracing spells.

scripts.speaker: Manager
scripts.text:
Did Captain Echinacea send you?
I have something to report to you.

scripts.speaker: Manager
scripts.text:
The magic wavelength of the requested pattern number has not been detected in this area.
It's not possible to trace the number around this area, but..
But?

scripts.speaker: Manager
scripts.text:
I can tell this magic pattern is supposed to be used to trace a human being.
You know tracing magic stones always come in pairs, don't you?

scripts.speaker: Manager
scripts.text: Now, magic stones specifically used to trace humans have a special feature.

scripts.speaker: Manager
scripts.text:
When the target of the trace dies, the pair of stones are automatically destroyed.
Since this patterned magic stone is still intact..

scripts.speaker: Manager
scripts.text:
Well, this magic stone serves as proof that the target of the trace is still alive somewhere in the world.
I'll keep watching.
Hopefully, we'll detect the same wavelength.

scripts.speaker: Manager
scripts.text: That's all for today.

scripts.speaker: Manager
Manager
scripts.text:
It's a fantastic product made from a combination of magic and science.
The Ash Vacuum hasn't been fully explored, and we don't know what kind of dangers to expect in this area.

scripts.speaker: Manager
scripts.text:
By using this device, we can check the change and flow of mana around this area,
and prepare for any possible threats.
- You cannot proceed with the quest when you're carrying too many items with you. -

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
Hey, you.
Don't get too close to anything except the gate.
It's too dangerous.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text: ......Do you have any business here?
Echinacea...
No.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
An assistant? I don't think I need one, but...
I guess I should give you something to do.
Do you mind if I entrust you with a chore?
Yes.
No, I don't mind at all.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
Then why did you come all this way?
I didn't really need any help to begin with. If you don't want to work, then stop bothering me.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text: If you don't want to help us out then go back to Echinacea and let her know yourself!

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
......
I don't know if Echinacea told you this already, but we are here
to follow the traces of Satan Morocc.
Some of us are here in the Ash Vacuum, and the rest are on the Midgard Continent.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
We exchange information with our colleagues in Morocc on a regular basis, but we haven't heard from them for a while.
How'd you like to go gather some information for me?
It should be simple, so you I hope you'll be able to handle this.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
At Southwest Morocc, you'll find an underground tavern.
Go find ^4d4dffRin^000000.
Tell her I've sent you, and she'll take care of you.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
If you don't have any business here, then step aside. It's too dangerous.
You might not be able to return to this world if you enter a route that hasn't been properly identified.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
I guess she forced you to do this, huh? Don't worry; you're not the first victim of her bossiness.
You should tell her if you really don't want to work for me.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
I can tell you aren't so happy with this, huh?
While you're here, why don't you help us out and see where it goes?
Don't worry, I won't give you a hard time...

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
......
I don't know if Echinacea told you this already, but we are here to follow the traces of Satan Morocc.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text: Some of us are here in the Ash Vacuum, and the rest are on the Midgard Continent.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text: We exchange information with our colleagues in Morocc on a regular basis, but we haven't heard from them for a while.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
How'd you like to go gather some information for me?
It should be simple, so you I hope you'll be able to handle this.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
At Southwest Morocc, you'll find an underground tavern.
Go find ^4d4dffRin^000000.
Tell her I've sent you, and she'll take care of you.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
Let me explain one more time.
Go speak to Rin in an underground tavern at Southwest Morocc.
You won't miss the tavern if you look for a boy named Jack standing out the front.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
Are you helping Rin?
..I see.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
I heard Rin is wounded and bedridden...
What happened?
- Instead of an answer, you gave him Rin's journal and the bloody crystal.-

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
...A journal? I see. Hopefully this'll help me understand the situation..
Hmm...

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
*Sigh*..
So Rayan has finally been located, huh?
There was a skirmish at the mountain, and.. a raid...
..So, how is she?
Huh?

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
I mean Rin. How is she?
Is she seriously wounded?

She needs to spend some time in bed,
but she's conscious and still in one piece.

She seems to have no problem taking care of herself,
but I'm worried because sometimes she looks extremely exhausted. She mentioned that her vision blurs when she's very tired..
Don't worry; I don't think it's serious because she still had the strength to yell while writing that journal.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
..Wh.. Who said I'm worried?
I asked about her because I don't want her injury to interfere with our schedule.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
As for you, I want you to come back later.
You're my assistant, remember?
I need you to substitute for Rin until she recovers..
Is that understood?

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
Hm, thanks for all your help.
Now, would you leave me alone for a while? I need to write a report based on the findings in this journal.

(I was supposed to give him the 'Morocc Pursuit Journal' and a 'Bloody Crystal of the Darkness'...
Err? Where have they gone? I need to find them.)

Kidd is standing at the side of the space gap, leafing through the journal's pages and taking notes.
The 'Bloody Crystal of Darkness' is sitting aside, and remains untouched.

I feel the crystal resonating with the space gap.
I suddenly have the urge to touch the crystal...

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text: Err? What are you trying to do?

No, nothing.
I'm sorry if I bothered you while you were writing your report.
- Kidd stopped you from touching the crystal, but somehow, it still captivates you. -

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
..Are.. Are you alright?
What just happened?
Err.. Huh?!

..Err?
..Kidd? Someone was calling my name...
Rin! Where's Rin? What about Rayan?

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
Rin? Rayan?
What are you talking about?
Where the hell have you been?

What do you mean..
Where I've been?
..Oh yeah, I saw Rin fighting Rayan.
She was defeated by magic, and then disappeared...

Ah?! Ah! Right!
I heard your voice once I found a strange scroll.
The scroll!
- Ignoring the confused look on Mr. Kidd's face, you searched your pockets, and found the mysterious scroll. -

- It wasn't a dream after all... What you saw actually happened. -
- You show Kidd the scroll and tell him what happened. -

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
... ..
.. Basically,
you found this from a member of Rayan's gang?

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
I know what this is:
it's a scroll containing a magic spell that can be used by anyone, even if they aren't trained as mages.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
Hmm, this scroll is sealed and needs some kind of pass code to use it.
I'll consult with the camp scholars about this scroll later.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
By the way, I saw you touch this 'Bloody Crystal of Darkness.'
There was a bright flash of light around you, and then you were suddenly drawn into the space gap.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
I thought I was just seeing things, but it's obvious now that it really happened.
You were actually in the past for a little while there.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
I'm afraid this space gap hides bigger secrets than we thought.
..It not only warps space, but also time ...
It warps space and time?

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
Forget it. I was just thinking out loud.
From now on, we should be extra careful about letting anything into this space gap. I need to report this incident to upper management.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
I'm sorry, but can you ask a scholar about this spell scroll?
If you don't know which scholar you should consult, then you'd better ^4d4dffask Echinacea^000000

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text: Thanks in advance.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
Did you find a scholar to ask about the scroll?
Huh? Not yet?
If you don't know which scholar to consult, then you'd better ask Echinacea.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
So this scroll is from Arunafeltz, huh?
Is that why you're gathering items to unseal the scroll?

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text: I see...

- Kidd is lost in thought. -
- Let's bring Defaria the items to unseal the spell scroll. -

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text: Keep up the good work, adventurer.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
This must be the spell scroll, huh?
It contains a teleportation spell
that will send the user to a specific location.. Hmm...

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
You said you've heard Rayan ordering others to come to a certain place.
If the spell of this scroll leads to that place..
.... . No, it's too dangerous.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
Then again.. Somebody will have to go there eventually..
... .. .. .
Why are you looking at me?!

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text: You're my assistant, aren't you?

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
.Alright, then. Would you rather capture reincarnations of Morocc and collect their remnants?
Scholars suspect the recent space-time phenomenon has been caused by the 'Bloody Crystals of the Darkness,'
so they want to study the crystals, which they believe are remnants of the of Morocc's reincarnations.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
That sounds way more dangerous, doesn't it? Go check that place out instead.
Both those missions are dangerous, but I think you'll be risking your life less by checking out that place.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
Now, listen. Use the spell scroll to teleport there, and then investigate the area. Find some clues.
Don't fight them.
Don't put yourself in danger, and retreat when things get too dangerous.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
By the time you come back,
we should have figured out the cause of the strange phenomenon near this space gap.
We'll think about everything else after you come back, alright?

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text: Where's the scroll? Did you use it?
Yes.
No.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
That scroll contains a teleportation spell.
Using it will lead you to a place that has something to do with them.
You're supposed to gather some clues once you're there.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
..I guess you haven't found any clues.
Do you remember the location of that place?
Why don't you go it check out again?

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
I'm sure you'll find something.
Yes, there must be some sort of clue there.
Do you understand?

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
That scroll contains a teleportation spell.
Using it will lead you to a place that has something to do with them.
You're supposed to gather some clues once you're there.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
If you lost the scroll, I expect you to find that place at any cost.
Is that clear?

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
Did you find any clues?
What did you find over there?
- You interrupted Mr. Kidd, and told him what you heard from the basement in the empty house near the national border. -

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
..Are you sure?
And the location is.. Okay, I got it.
Thanks.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
Can you go back and spy on them a bit more?
I'll follow you as soon as I report these findings to the higher-ups.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
They must be having a serious internal dispute,
meaning it's the perfect time for us to raid them.
Keep monitoring them for me, alright?

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
..Phew, now I've seen everything.
Oh, hey!
Where's Rayan?

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
He's locked up in the basement, and Rin is interrogating him.
You know, she's the best interrogator we've got. There'll be no escape for that guy ..

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
..Wait, what if the same thing happens..?
No way, that's not possible..

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
The crystal no longer resonates with the space gap.
Now it's exactly the same as a regular Crystal of Darkness.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
That means, the phenomenon that you've experienced with the 'Bloody Crystal of Darkness' can't be..
.........
Can't be explained?

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
..I guess not. It might have resonated to your mana or wavelength.
Why don't you carry it with you? Let me know if you experience any strange phenomenon again.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
Oh, and please bring ^4d4dffthis journal to Rin^000000.
This will be your last assignment from me.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text: ..Do you have any questions?
Is this an exchange journal?
Why should I carry the crystal?
What is this last assignment?

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
..No, not at all.
We're just using one journal to record each other's work.
Why can't you use separate journals and then combine them later?

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
......
Ask Echinacea. I'm just doing what the boss tells me to do.
Using one set journal is a good way to keep in contact and accumulate a history of work in chronological order.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
We came up with the idea to share our experiences
and understand any relation between incidents
as quickly and easily as possible..

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
I know it's a little bit counterproductive, but I'm satisfied with the quality of information shared between us.
The notes that Rin has absent-mindedly written down can turn out to be great clues for me..

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text: Yeah, I agree that the journal looks pretty disorganized.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
... Intuition... I guess?
... These kind of things.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
Rayan has already been caught, so the task to locate him and Rin is already done.
You were just an assistant to start with.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
Anyways, please deliver the journal to her safely.
I'm still not done yet; Echinacea already has another task for me..
..*Sigh*..

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
I asked you to deliver the journal to Rin.
You didn't forget it, did you?
...

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
By the way, I'm still not convinced that we've captured the real Rayan.
Will you tell Rin to write down the results of her interrogation in the journal?

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text: Of course, I'm pretty sure she'll do it without me reminding her.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
You don't have to report everything to me.
I can check the journal later.
Why don't you go assist Rin for now?

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
What's up?
I told you that I won't have any more work available for you. Well, for a good while, anyway..
Want a snack?
Mr. Defaria has sent me.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
..I guess he's finally made a fire, huh?
Tell him thanks for these sweet potatoes.
Ask about Dandelion.
Ask about Arunafeltz.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text: I'm indebted to them, but they all died before I had a chance to pay them back.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
If you're asking about my political opinion, I'm not going to answer.
This isn't something with which I can interfere.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
My personal opinion?
Let me tell you that, from their point of view; their one last chance was destroyed.
They're probably too ashamed to even talk about it.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text: Let our diplomats use that fact to their advantage, alright?

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
Nothing.
I have no comments.
No conflicts have arisen recently, either.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
Besides, nationality isn't important to us.
What's important is whether or not they're our enemies, and whether or not they're the target of our missions.

Err? I don't have two Nice Sweet Potatoes..
Where can I get those?

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
Don't try to understand everything.
A mission is just a mission.
Don't get too emotional or curious about it.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
...You'd better not approach the space gap off the official route.
If you're not authorized, then turn away. This thing is too dangerous for capricious exploration.
- You cannot proceed with the quest when you're carrying too many items with you. -

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text:
Please step aside.
I'm experiencing a turning point in my life right now.
.....
- The fire sparked, but then it immediatly blew out. -

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text:
...............
You know, that was my ninety-third attempt to make a fire with wet firewood.

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text:
Wait, was that the ninty fourth ot ninety fifth?
..I've.. I've lost count.

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text:
Please step aside.
I'm experiencing a turning point in my life right now.
......
- The fire sparked, but then it immediately blew out.-

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text:
...............
Are you also here...............
to make fun of my stupid attempt to roast these sweet potatoes with wet firewood?

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text:
...No? Then what brings you here?
...Huh?
A spell scroll? May I see?

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text:
...Isn't... Isn't this?!
...Hmm...
Eek... So Echinacea referred you to me, huh?
...Does that means she knows everything...?

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text:
...Alright then, I'll tell you.
As you can see, this scroll is sealed.
It can only be unsealed by a secret method.
...And...

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text:
...It is from....
...Arunafeltz?
The way it's sealed is the same method used by the temple...

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text:
I don't know how you've gotten this scroll,
...but I'll try to help you on behalf of the respectable scholars of Arunafeltz.

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text: But remember; I'm not doing this officially. Please don't make me disgrace my country by helping you. Do you understand what I'm saying?
Got it.
No.

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text:
Good. Then I expect you to help me by gathering the items I need to unseal the scroll:
^4d4dff30 Holy Waters, Runes of Darkness, and Bloody Runes^000000.

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text: I'll be waiting for your return.

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text:
At first, you looked like someone who is reliable and understands the difference between official and private matters.
Your answer just proved me wrong.
Echinacea must be getting desperate if she's asking people like you for help.

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text:
Oh, you've brought everything!
Good, it wasn't hard, was it?
Okay, can you come back in a little bit?

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text:
To unseal the scroll,
I need ^4d4dff30 Holy Waters, Runes of the Darkness, and Bloody Runes^000000.
Don't forget to bring the spell scroll along with them.

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text:
While you're gathering the items, I'll be roasting my sweet potatoes.
If I could only make this fire work...

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text:
Welcome back; you came at the perfect time.
First, this spell scroll contains a teleportation spell.
You know what teleportation is, don't you?

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text:
You know,
it's a spell that instantly moves you to a different location.
That's the spell contained in this scroll.

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text:
The only difference is...
This scroll will teleport you to a specific location.
Such scrolls are generally used by ^4d4dfforganizations to gather their members^000000.

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text:
I don't know where this scroll will lead you..
You'll be the one using this scroll. Am I right?
Here, please take this.

'To gather members...?'
...Right! I remember
Rayan mentioned a gathering somewhere!
So this scroll will take me to that meeting?

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text:
Um, do you mind? Would you stop talking to yourself and just leave already?
I'm sorry, but this old man needs some rest, alright?

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text:
Don't be so impatient.
You can come back later.
It'll take some time.

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text:
What are you so worried about?
You'll see how it works as soon as you use it.

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text: ..Huh? What do you want?

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text:
..I know they're involved in this case, but
we shouldn't talk about them.
Just tell me what you know.
Alright..

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text:
Why should I go through all that trouble?
You can go and ask Echinaea.
This old man needs some rest, alright?
I'll do anything for you.

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text:
Anything?
Are you serious?
Haha, got you!
Yes!

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text:
What th--! How dare you fool an old man!
You little punk!

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text:
I may be old,
but I'm a representative of great Arunafeltz's scholars!
It's a mistake to trifle with me like that!

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text:
Did you think I'm stupid just because I was trying to make a fire with wet firewood?!
..*Pant Pant*.. Phew, even yelling tires me out..

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text:
Then...
...Umm... Can you bring me some Logs?
...And some sweet potatoes too, if you don't mind.
Sure thing. How many?

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text:
...Let's see...
I need sweet potatoes for me, Mr. Kidd, and Echi... Umm...
...And then I need... Yes!

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text:
Please bring me ^4d4dff20 Sweet Potatoes and 30 Logs^000000.
I'll be waiting for your return.

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text:
You seem to give up really easily.
I don't blame you. Sometimes giving up is the best decision,
not to mention that it takes a certain kind of courage.

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text:
For example, Tarous that know when to abandon their hopes of getting cheese, you know, the bait in traps, are the hardest ones to catch. You know?
..Hahaha!

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text:
...Arunafeltz...?
Yes, I'm from Arunafeltz...
So what?

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text:
Be more specific about your question,
and stop being so ambiguous.

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text:
Oh, you've really brought what I wanted!
Please give them to me..
No, wait, can you pile them on the firewood over there?

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text:
Make it a nice, neat pile, please.
Oh, you forgot to put the sweet potatoes on top.
Yes, good. That's perfect.

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text: Hopefully I can make a fire with your nice logs....

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text:
Oh, this is as great as I'd hoped!
I guess my magic hasn't gotten that rusty after all..

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text:
If you want me to do you a favor, then
you should bring me ^4d4dff20 Sweet Potatoes and 30 Logs^000000 in return.
- Defaria is blowing on a roast sweet potato, peeling off it's skin. -
Excuse me, sir...

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text: What..?

Didn't you forget something?
... Dandelion? I wanted you to tell me what you knew.
I was hoping you'd remember something about Dandelion.

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text:
So,
do you want me to confirm
if Dandelion is really supported by Arunafeltz?

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text: Umm... I don't know what to say... I don't feel comfortable talking about politics.

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text: ...Do you mind delivering these to Mr. Kidd?
- Defaria has given you 2 Nice Sweet Potatoes. -

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text: Um, I just told you to deliver those sweet potatoes to Mr. Kidd.

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text:
Say, did he like them?
Hahaha...
... ...

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text:
Dandelion was like a ghost.
There are many different types of people in this world.
Some people want war while others are against it.

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text:
The Dandelions were the former case.
Those right-ists believed in a distorted patriotism. They thought shedding blood was the only way to make peace.

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text:
They organized Dandelion,
and they happened to ally themselves with the warmongers in the government.

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text:
That's how they grew so strong.
At first, their purpose was limited to gathering intel and spying on other countries.
This is just what I think, but the right information can cause chaos in a country.
Then what..?

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text:
Can't you see it by now? Isn't it obvious?
Well, if you can't take care of your own problems,
then you won't be able to handle your enemies.
So Arunafeltz planned all this!

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text:
No, it isn't that simple. The world isn't just black and white, you know?
Just bring these to Echinacea, will you?
They're cooked very well.
- You have received 2 steaming hot Nice Sweet Potatoes. -

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text:
I told you to deliver those cooked sweet potatoes to Echinacea.
Don't eat them, alright?

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text:
Muhahahaha!
Did Echinacea really say that?
She's an executive of the Rune-Midgarts army.
I can tell that what she said came from the bottom of her heart.

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text:
I'm relieved that things turned out this way.
After all, they're the reason why the three countries decided to cooperate.
Of course, it's too early to say if the cooperation will last long.

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text:
I just hope that the three countries will use this chance to form lasting, friendly relationships. Wouldn't that be great for the sake of everyone in the world?
Hrrm, but I'm not holding my breath for world peace.

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text:
I'm just a mere human who can't foresee the future, you know?
..Hahaha..

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text:
Ah, your sweet potatoes are now roasted very well.
Here, enjoy them.
Thank you for trying so hard to please this whimsical old man.

- Defaria is lost in thought, standing with a poker in one hand
and a sweet potato in the other. -

- Sometimes, he looks to the sky, sighs, and then says, 'I'm envious of young people these days ..'
or something like 'I don't care anymore, no matter what happens.' -
- It sounds like he's having some pretty deep moments, so let's not disturb him. -

scripts.speaker: Defaria
scripts.text:
Please leave me alone unless you have extremely important business with me.
I have so many things that I want to do...

You've found some half-burnt logs of high quality.
It seems somebody already roasted sweet potatoes with these logs.

You've found camp firewood that is too wet to make a fire.
It seems somebody has been futilely attempting to make a fire with them.

scripts.speaker: Jack
scripts.text:
Almost half of this town has been destroyed,
and yet some people still come to visit.
I must say that it's amazing that our stronghold is still intact, and withstood all the devastation.

scripts.speaker: Jack
scripts.text:
As you see, half of this town is gone. I guess there's no real reason to control access to this tavern.
Just feel free to go in.

scripts.speaker: Jack
scripts.text: I'm impressed by your courage to step into this hell.

scripts.speaker: Jack
scripts.text:
Oh, not everyone can enter that place...!
...
Nevermind.

scripts.speaker: Jack
scripts.text:
Since everything has changed,
just feel free to enter wherever you want!

^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service

Welcome.

There you go.

scripts.text: How many I help you?

scripts.speaker: Karred
scripts.text:
...Rin? I see. So you're assisting Mr. Kidd.
Rin...she's in the room inside.
She was gravely injured not that long ago...

scripts.speaker: Karred
scripts.text:
You can't expect your job to always go smoothly.
Of course there will be risks.
Why don't you go pay her a visit?

scripts.speaker: Karred
scripts.text:
Rin needs to rest for now. I hope you'll do what you can to help her out.
But please do take care of yourself as well.

scripts.speaker: Karred
scripts.text:
You and Rin are like my children to me, and such injuries...
Sigh...it's torture for me to see.

scripts.speaker: Karred
scripts.text: I hope you'll come by more often. This place is open to you always, even if you don't have missions.

scripts.speaker: Karred
scripts.text:
Rin needs to rest in bed for a while. I hope you'll help her complete her duties.
...This is quite embarrassing to admit, but I see her like my own daughter.

scripts.speaker: Litheron
scripts.text:
Ah, just forget what I said. That was out of line.
I guess I'm drunk after dealing with alcohol all day.

scripts.speaker: Karred
scripts.text:
How may I help you?
For your information, the 'recommendation' has lost its effect. You'd better go back.
I'm here for Rin!

scripts.speaker: Karred
scripts.text: ...? Why are you looking for Rin?

scripts.speaker: Karred
scripts.text:
I see. So you're a member of the Ash Vacuum expedition.
Rin is in the inner room.
...She's been badly injured and is resting in bed. Don't do anything to shock her, alright?

scripts.speaker: Karred
scripts.text: Hmmm.

scripts.speaker: Litheron
scripts.text:
Hey, wait.
Only authorized personnel can enter the inner room.
Hey Master, is it okay to let this guy in?

I, um, I'm looking
for somebody named
Marjana? I learned
that she's around
here somewhere?

scripts.speaker: Litheron
scripts.text:
Marjana? How did you
know that? Hey master,
what do I do with this guy?

scripts.speaker: Master
scripts.text:
Hmm. I sense no ill intent
from this adventurer. I've
also heard a rumor that the
Prontera Church needs to
investigate poison for
some reason.

scripts.speaker: Master
scripts.text:
However, there is no
way to tell if this person
has been sent by Prontera
Church. I suppose whether
this person can enter is
really up to you, Litheron.

scripts.speaker: Litheron
scripts.text:
Hah! Did you hear that?
Alright, how about this?
I'll let you in if you buy me
a drink. Besides, you can't risk making trouble here: this place
is full of deadly Assassins.
Sure
Why should I?!

scripts.speaker: Litheron
scripts.text:
Heh, that's what
I'm talking about!
Hey, bartender! Gimme
the usual! I like your
style, adventurer...

scripts.speaker: Litheron
scripts.text:
Huh...
Oh, you don't even
have enough zeny to
buy water here. Oh boy...
If you really want to enter,
make sure you have the cash!

scripts.speaker: Litheron
scripts.text:
Alright, you can come
on in. But don't you dare
breathe a word about this
bar to another living soul.

scripts.speaker: Litheron
scripts.text:
Not the saavy type,
are you...? Fine, fine.
If you're not gonna do
me any favors, then why
should I help you? Go away!

scripts.speaker: Bar Master
scripts.text:
If you keep outsiders away from the entrance, every drink you drink today will be on the house.

scripts.speaker: Bar Master
scripts.text:
Yay! Did you hear that?

scripts.speaker: Litheron
scripts.text:
What, haven't you seen a Knight before?

scripts.speaker: Litheron
scripts.text:
You know, I'm just here to take a break from the town restoration work.
There aren't many places that you can have a drink without being caught. You know?

scripts.speaker: Tao
scripts.text:
Welcome, meow.
Say, how's it like outside? Meow?

scripts.speaker: Tao
scripts.text: Why are you here, meow?
Is Marjana in?
I'm here to see you, Tao.

scripts.speaker: Tao
scripts.text:
She's in the room on your left, meow~
But then, how d'you know she's here, meow?

scripts.speaker: Tao
scripts.text:
This is no place for playing, meow..
... Hey, it's awkward you looking at me like that, meow..

scripts.speaker: Tao
scripts.text:
Tao knows what you're thinking, meow~ You're here to see big sister Rin, am I right, meow? 
Hehe, where is she, I wonder, meow~

scripts.speaker: Tao
scripts.text:
If you don't have any reason to be here, you should leave, meow!
Not everyone can enter this place, meow.
Somehow you're here, but you can't go in the room.

scripts.speaker: Tao
scripts.text:
No, wait... I think you may be able to go in... I don't know, meow!
Tao is tired of being a door keeper, meow! Meow!
Hey kid, are you alone?
What are you, meow?!
Why do you keep meowing?!

scripts.speaker: Tao
scripts.text:
Who are you calling a kid?
Tao is a good door keeper!
Don't call me a kid!

scripts.speaker: Tao
scripts.text:
I can tell you've got some reason for being here, but you've put yourself in trouble!
You're mistaken if you thought I would tell you
Master and Marjana are in the left room. Grrr.. Meow!

scripts.speaker: Tao
scripts.text:
Are you making fun of me being a door keeper, meow?!
Grrr...

scripts.speaker: Tao
scripts.text: You make me mad, meow. Get lost!!

scripts.speaker: Tao
scripts.text:
It's a long story, meow.
It's been a long time since I started meowing one day..
That day, Tao wanted to have a Big Ribbon so badly.

scripts.speaker: Tao
scripts.text:
So Tao went to find Wild Roses.
Meow?! Why am I telling you this, meow?!

scripts.speaker: Tao
scripts.text:
Grrr!
What are you, meow?!

scripts.speaker: Tao
scripts.text: Get out!

scripts.speaker: Tao
scripts.text:
Ah, that place is protected
by security magic, so you'll
only have ^4D4DFF4 minutes^000000 to remain
there. Don't waste time, meow!

scripts.speaker: Tao
scripts.text:
Sooo sorry, meow~
Someone else is already
inside. Just come back
again later, meow?

scripts.speaker: Tao
scripts.text:
Who are you, meow?!
Only authorized personnel can enter the inner room, meow!
You are not authorized!
Get out!

scripts.speaker: Valdes
scripts.text:
What is it? I have nothing to ask you to do.
Could you please leave me alone? I have a bad headache.

scripts.speaker: Valdes
scripts.text:
...Sorry, but could you please leave?
I'm really stressed out right now.
If you're here for the request that we made earlier, you can just forget about it.

scripts.speaker: Valdes
scripts.text:
I'll ask you for a help some other time.
You look pretty passionate after all.

scripts.text:

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text:
...{0}...?
It's been a long time. What's going on?

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text: Who are you? Only authorized personnel can enter this area.
Mr. Kidd sent me.
Just passing by.

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text:
...?
...Ah.. Ahh, I see.
I haven't contacted him for a while, and so he's sent you to me...
*Sigh*.. *Cough*.

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text:
As you see, I've been feeling under the weather. I'm in no condition to contact him.
...Let me think. Where I should start..?
I don't know if you know this, but something catastrophic happened in this town before Satan Morocc resurrected himself.

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text: R, otherwise known as 'Rayan,' performed a ritual to break Satan Morocc's seal.

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text:
We were able to gather a group of people and stop him from completing the ritual,
and although the seal wasn't broken, he succeeded in weakening it.

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text:
Soon after we captured him, an army of monsters attacked this town
as Satan Morocc's angry roars echoed in the air.

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text:
R, otherwise known as Rayan, is responsible for these series of events.

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text:
Our job is primarily investigating Satan Morocc's whereabouts
as well as the relation between the space gap and Satan Morocc...

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text:
We, however, couldn't let Rayan get away with what he's done
I've been focusing on pursuing Rayan.

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text:
If we capture him, we might also find out some information about Satan Morocc:
we might be able to learn where he tried to summon Satan Morocc, and where we should send Satan Morocc back to...

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text:
I really want to know how the space gap is linked to Satan Morocc...
*Pant Pant*... ...
And then what?
Don't strain yourself.

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text: I'm sorry, but I'm not yet fully recovered... I need to speak slowly. Please bear with me.

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text:
Thank you for your kindness.
...*Pant Pant*...

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text:
I received these injuries from Rayan and his gang. I finally located them after a long stakeout and pursuit...
......... ...

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text: Yes... I need to write this down...
- Mumbling something, she took down notes in an old notebook as she spoke. -

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text:
The Dandelions.. They're Rayan's puppets.
I was ambushed by them in a mountain far from a village...

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text:
When I woke up, I was here.
Since then, my vision's been blurry. I guess that must have been caused by my injuries...

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text:
How'd you like to conduct an investigation around that area? We might find something..

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text:

...God, I can't believe just let you come here!
Grr.. I need to teach them a lesson. Why can't they let me rest for God's sake!

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text:
I'm sorry, but I'm extremely tired and cranky.
If you don't have anything important to tell me, then I'd like you to leave.

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text:
So, are you interested in helping me?
I remember the location was... Southwest from a village called Hugel.
Do you know where to find Abyss Lake, where the Dragons reside?.

scripts.speaker: Rin

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text:
They ganged up on me, but I put up a good fight...
I'm sure I at least made them drop something..
Please try to find something there that might serve as a clue.

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text:
While you're gone, I'll be preparing a document to send to Mr. Kidd.
Be safe, and look out for yourself, okay?

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text:
I remember the location was...
somewhere south of the second hill of a mountain west from Abyss Lake.

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text:
What are you looking at?
How do I remember the location so clearly?
It's the last location where I searched for Rayan. How can I not remember?

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text: Don't underestimate me; I'm an elite member of my guild.

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text: Have you found anything?

- You told her you couldn't find anything regarding their whereabouts,
but you found the ''Bloody Crystal of Darkness'' in the bushes.

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text:
..This is...it.
You can feel the evil spirit just by looking at it.
This...there's no doubt. It's the same kind of crystal as the ones found on Satan Morocc and his minions.

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text:
But...this crystal...left there..
..Was it them who dropped it?
So it seems Rayan and Satan Morocc...there really is something going on between those two.

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text:
You've worked hard. Thank you.
Ha...
Just lying here, not being able to do anything...it's so frustrating.

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text:
Here, take this journal to Mr. Kidd.
It should've been done a while ago.
Oh, bring this crystal to him as well.

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text: Ah..the journal..Yes, I should record this incident onto the journal.

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text:
All done. Here you go.
Here's the journal and the crystal.
Take them to Mr. Kidd for me.

- You received the journal from Rin.
Instead of a journal, it's more like a bunch of documents being exchanged. -

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text:
..A bloody Crystal of the Darkness?
Can you show it to me?

Oh, I don't have it with me. I'll go bring it right away.
^4d4dff(Wait, what did I do with it? I didn't sell it or anything, did I?)^000000

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text:
Hurry up; deliver the journal and crystal to Mr. Kidd.
That's your job, isn't it?
*Pant* I need to rest now..

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text:
My eyes are blurry...
*Pant Pant*...

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text: ..Argh.. I'm still recovering .. I'm not supposed to move~
- You cannot proceed with the quest when you're carrying too many items with you. -

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text:
Hey, you've come back at just the right time.
Look at him; this is ridiculous.

scripts.speaker: Rayan
scripts.text:
I know what I did is unforgivable, no matter how good my reason might be.
..But... *Sigh*... It's too late to regret it now, isn't it?
Who is this?

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text:
Don't you know? He's Rayan Moore who dared to release Satan Morocc, deceive everyone, and bring havoc to this world.
And you know what?

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text: Not only that, he slaughtered his own comrades without mercy!

scripts.speaker: Rayan
scripts.text:
...Waaah!
..I.. I.. I killed them with my own hands!
*Sob*..
I'm.. I'm sorry..

- Rayan is shivering in fear.
He still hasn't gotten over the fact that he killed all of his comrades.-

What is going on?
He doesn't look like the Rayan I know.

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text:
I don't know. This Rayan seems to be a completely different individual than the one we know.
I guess this is what they call Multiple Personality Disorder.

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text:
This Rayan isn't the Rayan Moore that plotted the conspiracy,
but another personality hidden inside of him.

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text: Hey, calm down. Why don't you speak slowly?

scripts.speaker: Rayan
scripts.text:
..It was me.. I was only going to pretend to break the seal of Satan Morocc...
Don't you see? I meant for it to just be an act! I was going to throw the town in panic...

scripts.speaker: Rayan
scripts.text:
..That would be my chance to spread the teachings of Freya, our messiah.
Then something went wrong...

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text:
What?
Man, how can you be so stupid?!
*Sigh* Continue.

scripts.speaker: Rayan
scripts.text:
I was studying some documents for my plan, and then I found something by accident.
That was when I became a completely different person.. *Sob*

scripts.speaker: Rayan
scripts.text:
..My plan.. It was like I wasn't myself anymore. I wanted to release Satan Morocc for real.
I kidnapped children.. Threatened my comrades.

scripts.speaker: Rayan
scripts.text:
..I held the true ritual to break the seal and release Satan Morocc...
Wah.. My.. My head hurts.. This.. No, you can't.. Waaah!

scripts.speaker: Rayan
scripts.text:
..Grr.. You.. You foolish weaklings..
..I shall kill you.. No... Nooo!

- Suddenly Rayan started talking nonsense and then pulled his hair out in anguish.
It seems as if he is trying to resist the evil personality within him. -
Smack his head.
Punch his stomach.
Slap his face.
- Wanting to stop Rayan from going berserk, you smacked the back of his head with the journal. Rayan staggered and then fell to the ground. Nice job! -
- Wanting to stop Rayan from going berserk, you sucker punched him in the 'ole bread basket. Rayan staggered and then fell to the ground...! -
- Wanting to stop Rayan from going berserk, you slapped his face with the journal. Rayan staggered and then fell onto the ground. Wah! -
- By your sudden violent move, the Bloody Crystal of Darkness flew out of your jacket, and rolled on the ground toward Rayan. -

scripts.speaker: Rayan
scripts.text:
Ahh....
....? Isn't.. Isn't this?!....

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text:
Wah! What's going on?
Why is it suddenly..?!

Is this a time-space phenomenon?!
Why..? There's no gap here..?

scripts.speaker: Rayan
scripts.text:
Haha.. Muhahaha!
Muhahahahaha!!
He's come.. My master has arrived!!
As you command, master. I'm here to serve you!

scripts.speaker: Voice from Rayan
scripts.text:
^FF0000You insignificant humans!
I'll be back at full strength,
and I'll pay you back for locking me in the darkness for hundreds of years!^000000

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text:
What... What just happened?
Are you Rayan? Or are you someone else now?!

scripts.speaker: Rayan
scripts.text:
You're too late. My master has already departed!
I'm his loyal servant.
You're too foolish to understand his great will.

scripts.speaker: Rayan
scripts.text:
Haha... Muhahaha!
He's calling me!
He needs me now!

scripts.speaker: Rayan
scripts.text:
You're Rin, right?
This is the last time you'll ever see me.
Haha... Muhahahahaha!!

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text:
............
....Huh...?
What just happened?

...I don't know...
...I think he's gone...?

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text:
What's up?
I'm kind of busy right now.

..I've brought back the journal and something else..
..Er, sorry. I forgot to bring the journal! I'll be right back.

What should we do now?
You know, that voice.. Do you think it was Satan Morocc...?

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text:
..Maybe.
B.ased on what the more normal Rayan has told us,
it seems that another personality within him was forcibly created by Satan Morocc.

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text:
Satan Morocc must have chosen Rayan to break his seal.
He's been controlling Rayan from deep inside his mind..

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text: And... That Mad Rayan seems to have a connection with your Bloody Crystal of Darkness.

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text: I didn't see that side of Rayan until you came; he was very cooperative and feeble up until then.

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text: The original Rayan seemed to remember everything that happened while he was controlled by that mad personality..

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text:
He was in shock after learning that he's killed all his comrades with his own hand.
He started acting differently once you approached him. I must record all of this in the journal.

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text: Right. He completely changed once he touched the crystal, as if he himself became Satan Morocc.

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text: ..Damn it.
What should we do now?

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text:
Don't worry.
I've marked Rayan's body in case he ran away.
We can trace him down.

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text:
I'll give you the pattern number of his magic wavelength. Can you give the number to Echinacea?
She'll take care of the rest.

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text:
The pattern number is...
^4d4dff[{0}]^000000
Don't leave out even one character. Okay?

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text:
Here, bring this journal with you.
Please don't forget the pattern number. Alright? Make sure that Echinacea gets it.

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text:
Report to Echinacea in the Ash Vacuum, and give her the pattern number.
The pattern number is ^4d4dff[SDHF92F-SDF]^000000. Don't leave out even one character. Okay?

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text:
Report to Echinacea in the Ash Vacuum, and give her the pattern number.
The pattern number is ^4d4dff[VWNM94GVWN90]^000000. Don't leave out even one character. Okay?

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text:
Report to Echinacea in the Ash Vacuum, and give her the pattern number.
The pattern number is ^4d4dff[CM3-TRDFGHE0]^000000. Don't leave out even one character. Okay?

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text:
Ouch, my head...
Yes? Why are you back again?
What...you forgot the pattern number?
Sigh...Oh well.

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text:
Make sure you don't forget it again. The pattern number is...
^4d4dff[{0}]^000000. Don't leave out even one character. Okay?
Got it?

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text:
Sigh. Get going, then...
I need to take a break...

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text:
Ahhh~ I'm a sick person. I need to rest!
I don't want to do anything else~
Hurry up and go, don't bother me~
- For some reason, Rayan is shivering in fear. -

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text:
He's not being himself for some reason.
I'm just glad that he's sane enough to speak to me.
I don't know what's going on with him.
- You cannot proceed with the quest when you're carrying too many items with you. -

You have found a pile of dirt and deep tracks under thick bushes.
There are deep footprints and spilled blood around the area.

Some desperate fighting definitely happened here.
There are some broken branches to the side of a set of footprints that look like they're skidding backwards...
Somebody must have been fallen down on the ground, or...

I've been having a strange feeling around this area...
It feels like faint mana.. ?!... Yes, I can barely see an aura.
...What is this?
Ignore it.
Take a careful look.

Hmm.. This place must be where Rin fought with Rayan's gang.
I don't see anything that looks important.

As you took a careful look,
you notice something shining in the ground.
^4d4dffYou have found a 'Bloody Crystal of Darkness'.^000000

I don't think I'll find anything else here...
I should go back now.
I hope Rin will understand.

There are traces of a battle here, including spilled blood.
There's also a pile of dirt that seems out of place.
There are traces of a battle here, and spilled blood.

You find many footprints on the ground.
Considering all the blood on the ground, a battle must have occurred here fairly recently.
The footprints continue over the hill.
You found some footprints.

Somebody left a mark under this small tree.
The mark is weathered and faded,
but it is an arrow pointing southwest.

There's some scribbling on the tree,
but you can't decipher what it means.
A mysterious force is repelling you, and you're unable to push forward into this area.

As soon as you touched the crystal,
you feel your body being pulled into the space gap.
You remember Kidd's confused voice, screaming your name.

By the way, where am I?
Argh.. My head hurts...

.. ? Wh... What's going on?
I can't see things.. I'm getting dizzy...
What just happened?

Huh? Are they fighting?
I can hear a crowd of people coming...
Argh! It's too dark to see...!

scripts.speaker: Familiar Female Voice
scripts.text:
Shut up! It's creepy that you all look alike. Bring it on! I'm not afraid of you!
I'm not going to let you run away again!

... !!!!
Rin!!!!
Why? Why is Rin here? Wait, where am I?
Argh.. I can't move at all...

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text:
You're not alone. So what?
You're still coming with me!

scripts.speaker: Rayan
scripts.text:
Hah, how impressive! You run like a rabbit!
I should have you killed you when I had the chance.
I didn't expect you to be so persistent...

scripts.speaker: Rin
scripts.text:
That's what I wanted to say!
You played me like a chess piece,
and now I want to tear you apart in five pieces. Why don't you just shut up and surrender before I kill you?

scripts.speaker: Rayan
scripts.text: Hah.. You still have no idea, huh? You already lost this game, lady.

scripts.speaker: Rayan
scripts.text:
I'm sorry that I have to do this.
...
Kill her.
Rin-!!!

You feel helpless: you can do nothing but watch her slowly get overpowered..
Then, the pressure on your body suddenly dissipates.
- You cannot proceed with the quest when you're carrying too many items with you. -

You have found a laceration on the dead body;
he must have been killed by Rin.
Check his pockets.
Shake the corpse.
It's creepy to touch a corpse, but you have decided to check his pockets for any clues.

It's creepy to touch a corpse, but you have decided to shake and turn the body
to find any possible clues
And...

A scroll flew out of the body's jacket pocket.
You're not sure what this scroll is for, but obviously it seems pretty important.

^4d4dffYou have obtained a Sealed Magic Scroll.
Let's bring this to Kidd.^000000
You have found a Dandelion Member who was killed by Rin.
It's just a corpse, but there seems to be something unnatural about it.

Now's not the time to examine corpses.
You better take care of your living enemies first!

- You find a side door that leads to the basement.
A faint light is shining through the hinges.
There are people inside, talking loudly. -

scripts.speaker: Male Voice
scripts.text:
Hey Rayan, say something.
We did everything you asked,
but...

scripts.speaker: Male Voice
scripts.text:
...This is totally wrong.
We did something that we shouldn't have.
Come on, reconsider this.

scripts.speaker: Male Voice
scripts.text:
Rayan, Rayan!
All we wanted was just to shake up the town just a little bit,
not summon Satan Morocc! The ritual failed like we first planned, but...

scripts.speaker: Voices
scripts.text:
That's right. It failed, but what happened? Satan Morocc resurrected himself.
He'll bring the end of this world.
What have we done?!
We can't even go back to our country now!

scripts.speaker: Anxious Voice
scripts.text:
...We all knew that we would be disposed after we stopped being useful.. Just like pawns in a chess match.
But I'm curious.
Rayan...

scripts.speaker: Anxious Voice
scripts.text:
Rayan, say something!
What the hell's wrong with you?
Why, can't you still forget the Assassin?
...Hey, tell us. What should we do now?

scripts.speaker: Anxious Voice
scripts.text:
Let me ask you one question.
...Did you... Did you really summon Satan Morocc?
Did you?
Did you really ask us to help you resurrect Satan Morocc?!

scripts.speaker: Anxious Voice
scripts.text:
If your silence means yes, I'm out!
I didn't know then, but I know now. I'm leaving!

scripts.speaker: Rayan
scripts.text:
Incompetent weaklings.
I don't need you anymore.
Thank you for following my lead so far.
But you're nothing but puppets of the goddess.. *Giggle Giggle*

scripts.speaker: Male Voice
scripts.text:
Hey, hey! What are you doing?!
Why are you doing this?!

- You hear loud thuds and thumping in the midst of their yelling and screaming.
It sounds like they're having a serious dispute.-

...Rayan? ...Morocc? ...Resurrect...?
I have no idea what they're talking about. Why are they fighting?

scripts.speaker: Rayan
scripts.text:
You ignorant puppets..
You're too stupid to understand my master's great will...
...Oh, right. I completely forgot about 'it.' It's time to take it back.
What do you say? *Giggle Giggle*

What the?! Does he know I'm here?!
I'd better run!
- You used a Butterfly Wing.-

- The side to the basement is open.
You can enter if you want. -
Enter.
Do not enter.
You have decided to not enter the basement.

- This door seems to lead to the basement,
but it's locked pretty securely. -
A man covered in blood is standing at a corner with a mysterious grin.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
I guess it was the right timing.
By the way, who is this guy?
He looks kind of.. He's insane, isn't he?
Woah! Where did you come from?

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
...From somewhere.
Anyways...
What happened?
Who are you?

scripts.speaker: Man
scripts.text:
...Who am I...?
...I think I forgot...
They're all dead.. I've killed them.
Hehehe, I just followed the will of my master.
Muhahahahaha!!
No... No way!
Rayan?!

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
What? Is this really the Rayan we've been chasing?
..... !!!
Right, you said Rayan was having a dispute with his buddies..

scripts.speaker: Rayan
scripts.text:
...Ray... Rayan? That's my name? That's right...
I'm Rayan. Rayan Moore.
Who are you..?

scripts.speaker: Rayan
scripts.text:
Where am I? What's all this blood?!
...Huh? Where am I? What happened to my friends?

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
...I guess I was right. He really is Rayan Moore.
What's wrong with him?
He seems... He seems really confused. Maybe even unstable.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
Well, it's the perfect time to capture this guy before he can kill us.
Rin will know if this is the real Rayan because I've never seen him without his mask..

scripts.speaker: Mr. Kidd
scripts.text:
I'll bring this guy to Rin so she can interrogate him.
I'll see you at the camp.
- You watched Mr. Kidd arrest the unconscious Rayan and take out a teleportation item. You decide to return to town. -

scripts.speaker: Man
scripts.text:
I live to serve my master!
Are you his enemy?
DIE!

You find a horribly dismembered dead body.
It is disgusting to decribe the status of the Corpse!.

You find a horribly disfigured corpse.
that appears to have been crushed to death.

You find a terribly mutated corpse.
R.I.P.

You find a terribly mutilated corpse.
Rest in peace.

You find a horribly disfigured corpse.
... . . . . . !!!
